classification.difficultyReason: Complete short multiplication and division patterns using supplied numerical examples.

content.prompt: Fill in the missing numbers, using the pattern.

answer.worked:
Different signs give negative answers. Divide the magnitudes:
$$\begin{align*}6\div1&=6\\6\div2&=3\end{align*}$$
Therefore,
$$\begin{align*}6\div(-1)&=-6\\6\div(-2)&=-3\end{align*}$$
